raw:
@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in year 3 of residency in ICU"
      role subject ?x
      role location "Spitalul Floreasca"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "obtain transfer to"
      role subject ?x
      role destination "UMF Cluj"
      role time "2026"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
